newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fraser welcomed as superannuation trustee.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fraser welcomed as superannuation trustee.

text.p: Former Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Bernie Fraser's appointment as trustee of three industry superannuation (pension) funds was welcomed on Tuesday by the country's peak superannuation body.

Susan Ryan, executive director of the Association of Superannuation Funds of Australia (ASFA), said Fraser's new role would do much to focus public attention on the valuable role played by Trustees in supervising billions of dollars.
Fraser has been appointed a trustee of the Superannuation Trust of Australia, the C-Bus and the Australian Retirement Fund, ASFA said.
Fraser retired as central bank governor in September.
Prior to heading the Reserve bank, he was Secretary of the Federal Treasury.
